core_relationship: The content-disjoint internal controlled environment must cover the resource ontology and pre-outcome decision support exercised by the external domains. External user identity, dialogue, memory text, and outcomes never become internal training data.
same_runtime_stack_required: retriever, filter, threshold, tie break, and Top-k

RS: the same frozen topic-agnostic strategy Bank used by ESConv and EvoEmo

tests: cross-resource routing under real user-disjoint histories

support_gates.candidate_absent_policy: deterministic off before the learned head
support_gates.out_of_support_policy: abstain or off without deleting the row from the all-state external result

reporting.primary: all external states, unweighted and clustered by user
forbidden: claiming pure untouched zero-shot external evaluation
using external quality or risk outcomes to choose training data, features, thresholds, or models
letting internal MP_PREFERENCE success mask external MP_PROFILE failure
describing numeric descriptor support as semantic equivalence

MS_v1_5_scope.current_session_context: Fixed baseline context, not an MS action. The bounded ten-turn experiment supplies the complete current-session dialogue and no current-session summary.
MS_v1_5_scope.MS_SESSION: A bounded summary of one strictly completed prior session. This is the only V1.5 MS subtype.
MS_v1_5_scope.MS_PATTERN: Reserved for V2 because no qualified cross-session-pattern compiler currently exists.
MS_v1_5_scope.action_space: One MS bit; total actions remain 16.
hard_exclusions: last-user-message fallback represented as a summary
conflict with a visible current update
already fully visible in current-session context
